name: penrix-coding-core
description: Coding-agent operating contract for a non-programmer product owner: intent grounding, current-reality reconnaissance, task-contract checks, complexity admission gates, evidence classes, specialist-skill routing, runtime verification, and plain-language handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Owner intent, reality research, complexity gates, and evidence-based handoff
interface.longDescription: Use Penrix Coding Core to keep product authority with a non-programmer owner while the coding agent owns engineering decisions. It requires current project/external/user-field reconnaissance before implementation and against the final diff, routes engineering work to specialist skills, re-verifies LLM-generated task contracts against current reality, requires evidence before fallbacks/abstractions/retries and other new mechanisms enter the codebase, enforces honest runtime evidence classes, and reports outcomes in plain language.
defaultPrompt: Use Penrix Coding Core for this coding task.
Before coding, collect current project, upstream and real-user operational evidence that can change the implementation.
Check this task contract against repository reality before implementing.
Before adding defensive or generalized machinery, run the complexity gate and remove anything without current evidence.
Before final self-review, re-check the actual diff against current external and operational reality.
Verify this fix in the strongest available real environment.
